requirements.quote: An MQTT implementation MAY conform as both an MQTT Client and MQTT Server implementation.
requirements.condition: When one implementation provides both MQTT endpoint roles
requirements.required_behavior: The implementation is permitted to claim conformance as both an MQTT Client and an MQTT Server.
requirements.why_checkable: The implementation's exposed roles and declared conformance targets can be inspected independently.

requirements.quote: A Server that both accepts inbound connections and establishes outbound connections to other Servers MUST conform as both an MQTT Client and MQTT Server [MQTT-7.0.0-1].
requirements.condition: When a Server both accepts inbound connections and establishes outbound connections to other Servers
requirements.required_behavior: It must conform to the MQTT Client conformance target for its outbound-connection role.
requirements.why_checkable: Client-side behaviors on the Server's outbound connections can be tested against the Client conformance requirements.

requirements.quote: A Server that both accepts inbound connections and establishes outbound connections to other Servers MUST conform as both an MQTT Client and MQTT Server [MQTT-7.0.0-1].
requirements.condition: When a Server both accepts inbound connections and establishes outbound connections to other Servers
requirements.required_behavior: It must conform to the MQTT Server conformance target for its inbound-connection role.
requirements.why_checkable: Server-side behaviors on inbound connections can be tested against the Server conformance requirements.

requirements.quote: Conformant implementations MUST NOT require the use of any extensions defined outside of this specification in order to interoperate with any other conformant implementation [MQTT-7.0.0-2].
requirements.condition: When interoperating with another conformant MQTT implementation
requirements.required_behavior: The implementation must interoperate using only functionality defined by this specification.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: It must not require any extension defined outside this specification as a prerequisite for interoperability.
requirements.why_checkable: Two conformant implementations can be exercised with all external extensions disabled and successful interoperability observed.

requirements.quote: An MQTT Server conforms to this specification only if it satisfies all the statements below:
requirements.condition: When evaluating an MQTT Server's conformance claim
requirements.required_behavior: The Server would have to satisfy every statement in the referenced following list.
requirements.why_checkable: The required list begins after this chunk, so this evidence does not identify the individual behaviors needed for a complete conformance test.
